newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller holds news conference in crisis.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller holds news conference in crisis.

text.p: Turkish conservative leader Tansu Ciller called a previously unscheduled news conference on Thursday amid a scramble to find a new government after the resignation of Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan.
A spokesman said Foreign Minister Ciller would address the media at 1300 (1000 GMT) at her official residence. He did not say what Ciller would talk about.
Ciller is among the leading contenders to be chosen by President Suleyman Demirel to forge a new coalition from the splintered parliament.
Erbakan asked the president on Wednesday to appoint Ciller as the prime minister-designate so she can head a new coalition with the Islamists and take the country to the polls.
